short: Integral series in the height-two logarithm

statements.markdown: Statement 6.2 (CM3). In the situation of Statement 6.1, suppose moreover that −d is not a square modulo ℓ. Then there is a unit υ of the maximal unramified extension of Q ℓ such that the local series of the curve, composed with υ log F , has integral coefficients in that extension.

lean.fidelity_note: Lean writes inertness as the absence of a square root of $-d$ in $\mathbb Z/\ell\mathbb Z$. For each specified pair of invariants satisfying `IsGoodModel`, it asks for a norm-one scalar such that every coefficient of `uSer` after substitution by the scaled `ltLog` has norm at most one. The paper leaves the choice of good model implicit. Lean places the scalar and coefficients in the completion of the maximal unramified extension, where the paper specifies the algebraic extension.
